key_patterns: scripts/gen-diagram.js is a pure-DATA-driven, grid-laid-out, collision-asserted SVG/PNG generator. Content model (top of file): TITLE_TEXT, SUBTITLE_TEXT, FRAME_TITLE_TEXT, GROUPS (zone panels with row index + inclusive cols span + fill/stroke/color), NODES (cards with id/group/col/badge/icon/title/sub/subMono/details[]), PANEL_APP, PANEL_USERS, GOV_TITLE, GOV_TILES, FOOTNOTES, LEGEND, EDGES (shape h-row|v-col|trunk, from/to {id,port}, style solid|dashed, optional label/labelAt/labelBg/labelWrap). buildLayout() derives all geometry from LAYOUT constants + the grid; assertNoCollisions() runs 13 rules and main() calls process.exit(1) on any fail BEFORE writing. Flags: --dry-run (build+assert, no write), --debug (overlay). The engine HARDCODES exactly 2 rows (rowPanelY/cardsY are 2-element arrays) and 5 columns (loops for i=1..5; colX(5); gutter loop i=1..<5). Reserved routing 'channels' (rule 13) require every edge segment to lie inside the entry gutter / an inter-column gutter / a column corridor / the row gutter / the trunk band — so a new row/column MUST add its channels. gen-diagram.test.js imports ./gen-diagram and asserts the real layout passes every rule AND res.counts.cards === gd.NODES.length AND the nudge-negative case still bites. BASELINE VERIFIED GREEN: 11/11 tests pass; generator dry-run reports 0 collisions, exit 0, 10 nodes.
